title: Scope.
officialText:
The provisions of this chapter shall govern the inspection of quality, workmanship and requirements for construction. Materials, inspection and testing shall conform to the applicable standards listed in this code or in the rules of the department. See
Chapter 1 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code for additional provisions relating to materials, testing and inspections.
